title: OCCAM: Improved Single-Cell Representation Learning and Perturbation Effect Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.21959v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting the effects of genetic perturbations requires models that generalize beyond observed cell contexts and gene combinations. We introduce Occam, a multilayer perceptron (MLP) framework for representation learning and perturbation-effect prediction. Occam combines cell representations learned through denoising with gene interaction, text, and protein-sequence features. It achieves the highest aggregate representation scores for perturbation information and cell-type preservation with batch integration. In cross-context few-shot prediction, a perturbation and a cell context are each observed during training, but never together. Occam better captures the measured response patterns for these unobserved combinations than four retrained competitors or direct transfer of the same perturbation's measured effects from other training cell lines. translated_title: OCCAM：改进的单细胞表示学习与扰动效应预测
translated_abstract: 预测基因扰动的效应需要能够在已观察到的细胞环境和基因组合之外进行泛化的模型。我们提出了Occam，一个用于表示学习和扰动效应预测的多层感知机（MLP）框架。Occam将通过去噪学习到的细胞表示与基因相互作用、文本以及蛋白质序列特征相结合。它在扰动信息和保留细胞类型（含批次整合）方面获得了最高的聚合表示得分。在跨环境少样本预测任务中，某个扰动和某个细胞环境在训练期间各自被单独观察到过，但从未同时出现。与四个重新训练的竞争模型相比，以及与从其他训练细胞系直接迁移同一扰动的实测效应相比，Occam更好地捕捉了这些未观察组合的实测响应模式。在无需微调的情况下，Occam在所有被评估的模型中对扰动的区分能力最强……
tldr: Occam是一个结合去噪细胞表示与基因相互作用、文本及蛋白质序列特征的MLP框架，在单细胞表示学习和跨环境基因扰动效应预测方面均达到了最优性能。
en_tdlr: Occam is an MLP framework that combines denoised cell representations with gene interaction, text, and protein-sequence features, achieving state-of-the-art performance in single-cell representation learning and cross-context perturbation effect prediction.
